description: Get the top listener countries (or regions) for a show. NOTE: OP3 has no native geography query, so this counts raw download records and aggregates by country client-side. It is a representative sample, not an exact lifetime total. OP3 returns raw records oldest-first, so to keep the sample recent this tool defaults to the last `window_days` days (90) when you do not pass an explicit start. Each result has a download count and percent share. Needs a show UUID. Keep max_records modest to stay fast and within rate limits.

by.description: Aggregate by country code or by region (state/province) name.

end.description: End of the window, ISO date or datetime. Defaults to now.

max_records.description: How many download records to sample for the aggregation (default 5000, cap 20000). Higher is more accurate but slower.

start.description: Start of the window, ISO date or datetime (e.g. 2026-05-01). If omitted, defaults to window_days ago. OP3 records are oldest-first, so without a start the sample would otherwise be the show's oldest records, not recent ones.

window_days.description: When start is omitted, sample this many days back from now (default 90). Ignored if start is set.

name: op3_top_countries
